name: Appliance Status Sensor
description: The Appliance Status Sensor (SynchroLinc), which triggers when the power its appliance draws crosses a threshold.

extendedCommands.name: readSettings
extendedCommands.description: Reads the trigger threshold, holdoff and hysteresis.

values.name: triggerThreshold
values.description: The power, in watts, at which the sensor triggers.

values.name: holdoff
values.description: How long the sensor waits before sending, in steps of about 0.067 second, up to about 17 seconds.

values.name: hysteresis
values.description: How much the power, in watts, must change before the sensor checks whether to trigger.

extendedCommands.name: setSettings
extendedCommands.description: Sets the trigger threshold, holdoff and hysteresis.

parameters.name: triggerThreshold
parameters.description: The power, in watts, at which the sensor triggers.

parameters.name: holdoff
parameters.description: How long the sensor waits before sending, in steps of about 0.067 second, up to about 17 seconds.

parameters.name: hysteresis
parameters.description: How much the power, in watts, must change before the sensor checks whether to trigger.

notes: The SynchroLinc Developer Notes send 0x00 in D1 of the extended Get and Set, where most devices take 0x01, so they're described as extended commands.
The sensor sends its messages as soon as the holdoff has passed.
